about-us-desc: Premium Logistics is a leading shipping company based in Albania, specializing in shipping services. With years of experience in the industry, we have built a reputation for excellence, reliability, and customer satisfaction. Our dedicated team is committed to providing seamless shipping solutions tailored to meet the unique needs of our clients. At Premium Logistics, we prioritize efficiency, safety, and customer service, ensuring that your shipments arrive on time, every time.

premium-logistics-pioneers: At Premium Logistics, we provide first quality, cost-effective service, and smart solutions. Our 7 years’ experience in the shipping, transport and logistics industry is our strength, which supports us to deliver our promises to our customers.
premium-logistics-commitment: At Premium Logistics, we are proud to deliver excellence every time. Our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction is unparalleled. We offer innovative solutions to meet your logistics needs and ensure timely delivery.

sea-forwarding-description: Our sea transport services offer a cost-effective and reliable solution for shipping large volumes of cargo. With extensive global connections, we ensure timely and secure delivery of your goods. Whether it's full container loads or less than container loads, our team handles every detail, providing comprehensive tracking and support throughout the journey. Trust us to navigate the complexities of international shipping and deliver your cargo efficiently.
land-transportation-description: Our inland transport services provide seamless and efficient transportation of goods from their origin to the final destination. We offer reliable trucking services to ensure your cargo is collected and delivered on time. With our comprehensive network and experienced team, we handle all logistics, including pickup, delivery, and any necessary transfers, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free journey for your shipments. Trust us to manage your inland transport needs with precision and care.
warehouse-distribution-description: Our warehousing and distribution services offer secure storage and efficient handling of your goods. With state-of-the-art facilities and advanced inventory management systems, we ensure your products are stored safely and managed efficiently. Our distribution network enables timely and accurate delivery to your customers, optimizing your supply chain and enhancing operational efficiency. Trust us to provide comprehensive warehousing and distribution solutions tailored to your business needs.

faq-description: Everything you need to know about our logistics services and billing. Can't find the answer you are looking for? Please contact our support team.
feeling-inquisitive: Have a read through some of our FAQs or contact our supporters for help.
faq_title_1: How long will it take for my order to arrive?
faq_desc_1: For vehicles/orders from the US and Canada, delivery usually takes 30 to 60 days, depending on the departure port. Your order might ship from New Jersey, Indiana, Georgia, Toronto, or other locations, and you'll receive a live tracking number to follow your order in real time. For vehicles/orders from South Korea, delivery typically takes 30 to 45 days to reach the port of Durres. For vehicles/orders from China, delivery typically takes up to 60 days to reach the port of Durres.
faq_title_2: What type of delivery do you use?
faq_desc_2: For cars from the US and Canada, we use a combination of auto hauling for inland transport and container shipping to Durres port. For cars from South Korea, we use the safe and reliable RoRo (Roll on Roll off) transport method.For cars/orders from South Korea, we use container shipping as well for which you receive a tracking number
faq_title_3: How can I pay for my purchase?
faq_desc_3: Premium Logistics makes purchasing your vehicle from the US, Canada, China, or South Korea easy and hassle-free. Reach out to our agents for assistance with payment options and more details.
faq_title_4: I was referred to Premium Logistics!
faq_desc_4: Awesome! If you were referred by one of our happy customers, you’ll enjoy a 5% discount on your next purchase, along with free consulting. Contact us today to start shopping for your dream car!
